evidence_boundary: Only factual current-VCR side IDs, race, hull, static modifier attributes, mass and appearance order are analyzed as OBSERVATIONS. A game-specific static hull catalog and owner-perspective T-1 raw ship/engine/generator rows are independent contextual evidence; they do not establish host-phase precombat state. Horwasp clan intervals are inverse constraints using an UNVERIFIED linear rule and are NOT predictions. The right-carrier +360 branch and Shield Generator activation are not predicted. No RNG, effective weapon setup, Horwasp attrition algorithm or combat rule is promoted.
